purpose: Define structural event labels from ordered joint top-three probabilities Q(i,j,k), record applicable official rules and unresolved historical evidence.
not_an_authorization_for: historical wager availability or payout reconstruction without race-level evidence

plc_field_split.field_count_basis: number of starters when ticket sales begin
plc_field_split.below_5: PLC cannot be run under the statutory minimum
plc_field_split.actual_starter_lower_bound: If actual starters are a subset of the sales-opening roster, N_actual >= 8 implies N_at_open >= 8; store as an inference, never as an observed opening count.

event_space.race_condition: Valid structural race with distinct horses occupying confirmed places 1, 2, and 3; ties and unresolved/cancelled races are outside the strict Q contract.
event_space.q_definition: Q_r(i,j,k) = P(place1=i, place2=j, place3=k), for distinct i,j,k in the forecast roster.
q_invariants: sum over all ordered distinct triples Q = 1

pools.event: i is Top2 if sales-opening roster has 5-7 horses; i is Top3 if it has at least 8
pools.probability: PTop2(i) or PTop3(i), determined only from observed N_at_open or explicit actual-starter lower-bound inference
pools.unknown_rule: If N_at_open is absent and N_actual < 8, event label and forecast target are unknown; exclude PLC only from this race's PLC denominator.

pools.event: i and j occupy places 1 and 2 in either order
i and j are both in places 1-3, in any order
pools.probability: sum over k distinct from i,j of TLA({i,j,k}), equivalently all six Q orders for each such k

pools.event: i is first and j is second
i,j,k occupy places 1-3 in any order
pools.probability: sum of the six Q permutations

pools.event: i is first, j second, and k third

pool_mass_checks.warning: PLC and QPL tickets overlap and can win simultaneously. Their event-probability sums are not 1 and must not be normalized into a single-winner categorical distribution.

multiple_winner_metrics.aggregation: mean over eligible tickets within each race, then equal weight over races

scoring_contract.boundary_probability_policy: Fix clipping/handling before viewing evaluation results.
scoring_contract.comparison_note: Do not interpret PLC/QPL ticket events as independent; do not rank pools by raw loss magnitude across different event spaces.

statute.article_8: Pays winning tickets; if no winning ticket, refund applies. In multi-winner methods, a share with no matching ticket is distributed to other winning tickets under the statute.
statute.article_10: Race/ticket invalidation and refund cases include no-contest, impossible pool after scratch/exclusion, no winner for the pool, and tickets containing nonstarters.

dead_heat.rule: Rules §5 and its annex divide ordinary payout fund across tied winning horses and winning ticket units; PLC and QPL use separate rank-position/combination allocation tables, with analogous treatment for unlisted cases.
dead_heat.model_scope: Exclude tied Top3 from strict Q event evaluation and retain a dead_heat ledger code; do not infer payout from the strict-order label.

settlement_and_exceptions.race_not_established: Rules §8 and KRA guidance: one re-start may follow a start failure; if the retry also fails, race is no-contest. A no-contest ruling means finish order is not accepted and purchased tickets for that race are refunded, even if horses crossed the finish line.
settlement_and_exceptions.nonstarter: Rules §9: single-horse WIN/PLC tickets on a nonstarter are invalid; combination tickets containing a nonstarter are invalid. KRA Jeju guidance describes refund/exchange; after valid start, a non-finisher is not refunded.
settlement_and_exceptions.official_rank: Use the final confirmed KRA order after steward review; unresolved objections or rank changes remain excluded until resolved.

historical_change.new_mismatch_invalidation: The Act §10(1)(3) runner-list mismatch ground and §10(7) post-confirmation payout protection were added 2022-12-27 and effective 2023-03-28.
historical_change.applicability: Do not apply this new mismatch ground retroactively to 2019-2022 races; use event-level historical KRA rulings where available.

cohort_contract.recommended_conservative_common_7_pool_s: Official valid/completed and roster-verified strict unique Top3 races with N_actual >= 8; this is a recommendation, not the active experiment's denominator.

active_f1_structural_cohort.plc_field_rule: For N_actual >= 8, use Top3 only as lower-bound inference conditional on starters being a subset of sales-opening roster. Set N_at_open=null, N_at_open_observed=false, N_at_open_lower_bound=8, plc_rule_basis=actual_starter_lower_bound.
active_f1_structural_cohort.small_field_rule: The 36 N_actual=7 races have unknown PLC split absent opening-roster evidence; exclude only from PLC. Keep them for WIN/QNL/QPL/EXA/TLA/TRI, whose event definitions do not depend on the PLC split, subject to their own statutory minima.
active_f1_structural_cohort.scope_caveat: Existing frozen cohort is a structural normal-finish/complete-field event sample. KRA official valid/completed status and actual ticket offering/settlement were not exhaustively audited for every race; do not describe this as full market reconstruction.

cohort_contract.synthetic_branch: If testing the 5-7 Top2 PLC rule synthetically, supply N_at_open explicitly and label the branch synthetic; do not substitute actual field size or mix it with observed cases.

market_comparison.posthoc_proxy: If D is the final gross payout multiple, p*D-1 may be reported as a final-price ex-post expected-return proxy.
market_comparison.not_supported: Final odds have no verified first-publication/purchase timestamp in the existing audit, so they cannot establish executable pre-purchase strategy ROI.
market_comparison.this_experiment: No return or ROI analysis is run.
market_comparison.inverse_odds: Normalizing reciprocal final odds across all tickets does not create a coherent one-winner distribution for overlapping PLC/QPL events.
future_comparison_requirements: same unit budget and combination count

historical_scope_and_unresolved: Current §4 is directly verified in the 2024-06-21 version. The official 1995 historical regulation also records the 5-7/8+ PLC split; this confirms that split in the two checked versions, not uninterrupted product availability or every intermediate amendment.

The 2009 full revision and current §4 retain the seven event definitions; the current article annotation shows 2013, 2020, and 2021 amendment dates. Historical Jeju pool offering must be verified race-by-race.
For 2019-2022, do not retroactively apply the runner-list mismatch invalidity rule first effective in 2023; original race-level invalidity/refund rulings are preferred.
Historical opening-roster counts, exact PLC split for N_actual < 8, and all historical pool availability/race committee decisions are not verified by this contract.
Ties are not modeled; payout table was read and verified, but the current Q contract excludes ties.
